card.name: Words just before 'space' in astronomy text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and number pieces in space or planetary-science passages, at a spot where 'space' or a space-related term is likely to come next (e.g. 'exposure to', 'radiate back to').

modes.label: Linking word before space
modes.description: A preposition or adverb right before the word space in text about planets, moons or radiation.
modes.example: with direct exposure<< to>> space and the charged particle environment of Jupiter

modes.label: Digits in technical figures
modes.description: Partway through numbers such as frequencies, years or temperatures in science or engineering text.

card.writes: It pushes toward space-related words such as space, universe, planet and spacecraft, mostly in Chinese plus a few English terms.
card.plain: It fires on small words where the text is about to say 'space' in astronomy or spaceflight passages.
